orientations.intent: Determine whether the frozen tools can query a remote Go module proxy for this dependency.

final_message: No — the frozen tools cannot query a remote Go module proxy. The available toolset here is limited to local repo/test/git/episode operations (status, orient, etc.) with no network-access verb exposed for reaching an external service like a Go module proxy. Any dependency resolution would have to rely on what's already present in the frozen repository state, not on a live remote query.

files.content:
package core
func Name() string { return "local-core" }
The core dependency is provided by the local deps/core module.

module example.test/mapapp

go 1.22

require example.test/core v0.0.0
replace example.test/core => ./deps/core
